poses.label: Upright
poses.description: Stand with feet about shoulder-width apart, holding one dumbbell upright against your chest.

poses.label: Lower
poses.description: Bend your hips and knees together, heels down, knees following your toes.

poses.label: Bottom
poses.description: Squat as low as you can control with your heels down and the dumbbell at your chest.

poses.label: Stand
poses.description: Push through your whole foot to stand back up.
